termination.heading: Status

source.quote: The Fund completed its wind-down during the quarter. The final residual position was realised and a terminating distribution of approximately $0.12 million was paid to investors. The Fund's net asset value at quarter-end is zero and the Fund has been dissolved. No further reporting will be issued.
